skill.summary: Get trimmed video clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your raw video clips (MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI, up to 500MB), say something like "...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of trimmer-canva.

- Instantly trim and export Canva videos through simple chat prompts, no manual editing required.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI files up to 500MB.
- Automatic backend session and token management for quick start without registration.
- 1080p MP4 export with fast cloud processing (~30–90 seconds per render).
- Clear feedback on connection, status, errors, and supported actions throughout the workflow.
